title: Premiere Dent Dental Clinic
description: Developed a cohesive visual presence for the clinic through branding, social media content, and digital marketing assets. Created graphics and promotional content that maintained a clean, professional, and approachable brand identity across online platforms.
overview: Developed and continue to manage Premier Dent Dental Clinic’s visual and social media presence, including brand identity, marketing materials, and digital content. I help maintain a consistent and professional brand across its platforms while supporting its ongoing marketing efforts.
problem: Premier Dent needed a more consistent and professional visual presence across its social media and marketing materials. The existing content lacked a unified visual identity, making it harder for the brand to communicate a recognizable and trustworthy image.
solution: I developed a consistent visual direction for the clinic, including social media designs, promotional materials, and branded content, while maintaining a professional and approachable look suitable for a dental healthcare brand.
process: 01 | Understand
Discussed the client’s vision and desired brand identity to establish a clear creative direction for the startup.
02 | Define
Established a consistent visual direction, including typography, layouts, colors, and content style.
03 | Create
Designed social media posts, promotional graphics, and marketing materials aligned with the brand.
04 | Refine
Reviewed and adjusted designs to maintain consistency across different content and platforms.
05 | Maintain
Continue creating marketing materials and digital content to keep the brand’s visual presence fresh and consistent.
outcome: The brand gained a more cohesive and recognizable visual presence, with marketing materials that consistently reflected the clinic’s identity across different platforms.

hero.alt: Premiere Dent Dental Clinic branding and social media design
hero.description: A polished digital design system for a dental clinic with a clean, reassuring aesthetic and strong visual clarity.

title: Jesus Reigns Ministries Social Media Volunteering
description: Created social media content, event posters, promotional materials, and edited videos to support the ministry's events and strengthen its online presence. Developed engaging visuals while maintaining a consistent and recognizable visual identity across digital and event materials.
overview: Volunteer creative supporting Jesus Reigns Ministries Barcelona through weekly and event-based visual content. Collaborate with the team to create posters, presentations, roll-up banners, and promotional materials for ministry activities and events. Also manage and publish social media content, helping maintain a consistent and engaging online presence for the ministry.
problem: The ministry has a consistent weekly demand for promotional and visual materials to communicate upcoming activities, events, and announcements. The challenge is to produce engaging and consistent content on a regular basis while helping the ministry reach a wider audience and maintain an active social media presence. This includes managing frequent design requests, adapting content for different formats such as social media posts, presentations, posters, and roll-up banners, and ensuring that promotional materials are delivered on time for each event.
solution: Developed and maintained a consistent visual content workflow for weekly ministry activities and events. Collaborated with the creative team to design posters, social media graphics, presentations, and roll-up banners, ensuring materials were ready on time and aligned with the ministry’s visual identity. Supported the ministry’s social media presence by regularly publishing promotional content and adapting designs for digital platforms, helping communicate events effectively and increase audience reach.
process: 01 | Communication & Planning
Coordinate with the media team to understand the event, required materials, photo angles, content, and overall creative direction.
02 | Ideation & Brainstorming
Develop design concepts and brainstorm ideas with the team, gathering suggestions and discussing the best visual approach.
03 | Design & Production
Create the required promotional materials, including posters, social media graphics, presentations, and event banners.
04 | Review & Refinement
Share the designs with the team for feedback, make revisions, and ensure everyone is aligned on the final visuals and messaging.
05 | Publish & Deliver
Finalize the approved materials and publish the content across social media or prepare the materials for the upcoming event.
outcome: Established a consistent and organized visual presence for Jesus Reigns Ministries Barcelona through regular promotional content and event materials. The workflow helped the team communicate events clearly, maintain visual consistency, and reach a wider audience through timely social media content and engaging promotional designs.

hero.alt: Jesus Reigns Ministries social media and event design
hero.description: Event-driven creative work designed to inform, inspire, and connect the ministry's community online.

title: 3D Bubble Cutting Machine
description: Designed and modeled a bubble cutting machine in 3D, creating a detailed digital model of its structure and components. Added a simple animation to demonstrate the machine's movement and functionality.
overview: Created a 3D model and animation of a bubble wrap cutting machine, showcasing its main components, basic functions, and how the machine operates. The animation visually demonstrates the assembly, movement, and cutting process to make the machine’s functionality easier to understand.
problem: The client needed a 3D model and animation to demonstrate the machine’s design and functionality, but previous outsourcing options were costly and did not accurately meet the project requirements. The challenge was to create a more affordable and accurate visual solution that reflected the actual product, its components, and how it operates.
solution: Created a custom 3D model, product images, and animation based on the client’s actual product and requirements. Despite having a limited timeframe, I efficiently modeled the machine’s key components and animated its basic functionality, delivering the final visuals on time and within the client’s deadline. The result was a more accurate, cost-effective, and practical visual solution for presenting the product.
process: 01 | Client Brief & Discovery

Set up a meeting with the client to understand their vision, requirements, and deadline for the product images and animation. Discussed the machine’s basic functionalities and requested any available technical documentation, references, or product materials to accurately visualize the machine.
02 | Planning & Preparation

Planned the 3D model by identifying the individual components, measurements, materials, and moving parts needed. Organized the workflow and prepared the necessary elements before starting the modeling and animation.
03 | 3D Modeling & Animation
Built the machine and its key components in 3D, then developed the basic movements and functionality animations to demonstrate how the parts work together and how the machine operates.
04 | Review & Refinement

Presented the progress to the client and gathered feedback on the visuals, animation, functionality, and overall presentation. Made the necessary adjustments to ensure the final output matched their expectations.
05 | Final Delivery
Finalized and rendered the 3D animation and product images, then met with the client to review and deliver all the completed materials within the agreed deadline.
outcome: Successfully delivered the 3D model, product images, and animation within the client’s deadline, meeting the agreed requirements and requested functionality. The final output accurately represented the machine and its key components, and the client was satisfied with the completed work and overall result.

hero.description: A 3D concept visualization of a bubble cutting machine showcasing the product in motion and form.

title: Diamond Law Center Postcard Design

overview: This project centered on creating clean and persuasive postcard and print materials for a legal brand.
problem: The client wanted marketing materials that looked professional, organized, and trustworthy while staying easy to read at a glance.
solution: I designed a simple postcard layout with strong hierarchy, brand-friendly styling, and clear messaging for quick communication.
process: Studied the brand's audience and positioning.
Developed a clean print layout with strong readability.
Applied a consistent visual system across the final design.
Adjusted spacing and composition for clarity and polish.
challenges: The design needed to balance professionalism with a polished aesthetic while keeping the information easy to scan.
outcome: The final design gave the client's marketing material a cleaner, more high-end presentation that better represented the brand.
